title: TCD-040 Provenance-Pinned Independent Replay Evidence Bundle

blockers.detail: The current B0 evidence register still has null controlled-storage record identifiers, no immutability proof reference, no post-ingest and secondary-copy verification, and no passed restore test for source, testbank, or user guide. Transient supplied bytes were hash-matched locally but are explicitly not controlled-retention proof.

Repository governance prohibits publishing the raw source archive, raw testcase archive, the copyrighted user-guide PDF, or functionally equivalent unpacked copies without explicit redistribution authorization. This workunit therefore cannot solve the acquisition blocker by committing those bytes to the public repository.

The immutable B3B04 tree contains its validator and summary evidence but not the Stage-A/Stage-B replay implementation, raw checkpoint payload, continuous trace, defective trace, corrected trace, or split-67 trace. Reconstructing new scientific evidence would exceed this remediation workunit's instruction to make the existing evidence independently reproducible without silently creating a replacement claim object.

No governance-approved non-secret immutable acquisition reference is available to GitHub Actions. An actual independent executable replay in CI is therefore not presently possible without violating provenance or redistribution policy.

resume_condition: Resume B3B04E1 only after a B0 Evidence Custodian supplies governance-approved immutable acquisition references for the exact source, testbank, and user guide, and the original B3B04 replay implementation plus required payloads are made available or explicitly authorized for provenance-pinned reconstruction. Then execute the bundle validator in full replay mode. Do not create a reconsideration review branch before that gate passes.
